question: Who among the following was the student of 'Pandit Birju Maharaj' and received ‘Padma Shri’ in the year 1992 and 'Sangeet Natak Akademi Award' in the year 1999-2000?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Shovana Narayan.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Shovana Narayan** was a student of** Pandit Birju Maharaj** and received** Padma Shri in 1992** and **Sangeet Natak Akademi Award** in **1999-2000.**
 
• **Kalamandalam Kalyanikutty Amma** was a renowned **Mohiniyattam dancer** from **Kerala **who received** Padma Shri in 1999.**
 
• **Mrinalini Sarabhai **was a famous** Bharatanatyam dancer** and choreographer who received **Padma Bhushan in 1992** and** Padma Shri in 1965.**
 
• **Yamini Krishnamurthy **was a renowned **Kuchipudi and Bharatanatyam** dancer who received **Padma Shri in 1968, Padma Bhushan in 2001, and Padma Vibhushan in 2016.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Pandit Birju Maharaj** is a renowned **Kathak dancer **and choreographer who belongs to the **Lucknow gharana.**
 
• He is a recipient of several awards, including **Padma Vibhushan, Sangeet Natak Akademi Award, and National Film Award for Best Choreography.**
 
• **Padma Shri** is the **fourth highest civilian **award in India, while **Sangeet Natak Akademi Award** is a national-level award presented by the Sangeet Natak Akademi, India's national academy of **music, dance, and drama.**
